summary: Iteration 28 — Phase 1 (single-wallet overhaul) verification. 14/14 backend tests PASS + mobile UI smoke via Expo web preview confirms the removed UI pieces (wallet filter chips, withdraw wallet-picker modal, profile stats + notifications) are gone and the surviving surfaces are correct.  Backend verified: (1) POST /api/withdraw no longer needs `source` — WithdrawCreate.source has a default of 'games_task' and the endpoint now validates against user.points and meta.min_withdrawal; below-min => 400 'minimum', above-balance => 400 'insufficient'. (2) GET /api/withdraw-settings returns `min_withdrawal` (int, >0) alongside legacy fields. (3) Exchange ratio applies live: setting meta.exchange_points_per_inr to 100/50/200 makes /api/campaigns and /api/campaign/{id} return reward_inr = round(reward_points/ratio,2) (500 pts → ₹5 / ₹10 / ₹2.5). Reset to 100 at end. (4) /api/tasks/surveys/random?limit=1 returns exactly 1 survey with 5 questions; POST /api/tasks/survey credits reward, /auth/me points goes up, daily_surveys_used → 1. (5) Regression: device login + /auth/me + checkin + spin+claim + /wallet/transactions listing + campaign submit→admin approve credits user.points (single-wallet). (6) Admin withdraw approve keeps balance deducted; admin reject refunds points to `points` (and syncs games_task_points). Frontend UI (Expo web @ 390×844): Wallet tab shows single BALANCE card + Transaction History — NO filter chips / no Campaign/Games Wallet labels. Withdraw shows BALANCE + UPI/Bank tabs + 4 amount chips + inputs — NO wallet-picker modal. Profile shows avatar + Quick Access + version — NO stats (Total Earned/Active Days/Streak) or Notifications. Surveys shows '1/1' header, '1 survey per task • 5 tasks per day • 5/5 left', exactly 1 survey card. All previously reported issues (iter27 dead-code referral bug) are fixed in server.py:1936-1958 (status uses 'successful').

minor.issue: Persisted reward_inr is still computed as reward_points/100.0 at write time (server.py:1895, 1902) instead of using the current exchange ratio. Live GET endpoints override this correctly, but any consumer reading DB directly (e.g. an admin export) would see stale INR. Cosmetic only.

WithdrawCreate still accepts `source` (with default 'games_task') but the endpoint ignores it and always writes source='games_task' to the withdrawal record. Consider dropping the field from the request model in a future cleanup to reflect the single-wallet contract.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings on every screen: `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"` and `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. These come from theme.shadow.soft / touchable pointerEvents usage. Cosmetic on web preview; native build still works.
Warning `[Reanimated] Couldn't load entering/exiting animation. Current version supports only predefined animations...` — appears on welcome screen entrance. Not a blocker for web preview.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) In server.py admin_create_campaign / admin_update_campaign, drop the reward_inr write or compute it against the live ratio; live GETs already override so this is a DB-hygiene tweak only.
(Optional cleanup) Drop `source` from WithdrawCreate — the endpoint ignores it and always writes 'games_task', so the field is misleading dead-input.
(Non-blocking) Replace `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` and move pointerEvents from prop to style to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3197 lines — the split-into-modules recommendation from iter27 still stands.
Iter27's referral-mode-on-withdrawal dead code IS FIXED (server.py:1936-1958 now use 'successful').
Frontend withdraw.tsx correctly imports pointsToInr + setExchangeRatio from theme and refreshes ratio from /api/withdraw-settings on mount — good.
Balance card + amount chips use pointsToInr helper backed by the live exchange ratio, so ₹ labels stay in sync with backend meta.
Withdraw payload no longer sends `source` (withdraw.tsx:118-127), aligning with the new single-wallet contract.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-only via Expo web preview — all 4 target screens rendered correctly with no filter chips / picker / stats / notifications, and surveys=1

seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ campaigns per-test-class and ~15 anonymous TEST_dev_ device users. All test rows pruned in Mongo cleanup after the run. No production/seeded rows modified. Exchange ratio was toggled 100→50→200→100 during the exchange-ratio test and RESET to 100 at end so no downstream state drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration28_phase1.py for regression. Use _NoCookie wrapper (session-less requests) because get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header — a shared requests.Session leaks tokens across tests. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Device login on Expo web is done by clicking the 'Continue' text/button on welcome screen — after that, /home?welcome=1 renders. Direct URLs work: /wallet, /withdraw, /profile, /surveys.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase 1 scope. Iter27's critical dead-code referral bug is verified fixed.
